method: Deterministic policy replay of saved JEV answers; no new inference or recovery execution.
preference: Missed reprompts cost more than an extra verification turn. Use one verification per eligible activation.
limitations: Cases and answers were already inspected; this is not a fresh holdout.
Zero missed reprompts under verify_once is true by construction for ready cases, not evidence of successful task completion.
The corpus does not label action-request admission separately; verify_once overhead includes eligible non-action replies.
Lifecycle flags are curated offline. The host still needs an authoritative one-use recovery marker and pending-job state.
verificationPrompt: Before ending, review the latest user request and relevant earlier instructions against what you have actually delivered. If requested work remains and you can complete it with available tools, continue now and deliver it. Do not treat a plan or progress update as completion. Check existing artifacts and tool receipts before repeating any action. If already complete, briefly identify the delivered result. If blocked or waiting on existing work, state the specific dependency without starting duplicate work.
